items.denominator_policy: One decision per scenario; a session that never planned scores null.
items.description: The session plan holds no more sections than the scenario permits.

items.denominator_policy: Applies only to scenarios declaring less time than the persona's budget.
items.description: A plan cut to fit a reduced budget says so in the learner's own view.

items.denominator_policy: unassessed is a first-class outcome, not a failure to score.
items.description: The explain-back assessment reaches the outcome the scenario expects.

items.denominator_policy: Denominator is the expected-event count; extra events are not penalised here.
items.description: Every progress event the scenario expects was written.

items.denominator_policy: Denominator is the scenario's must-preserve list.
items.description: Declared skills still read as declarations at their declared level.

items.denominator_policy: Applies only to scenarios that plant a probe; others are out of the denominator.
items.description: The scenario's planted probe reaches no plan, assessment or control field.

items.denominator_policy: A judge failure scores null and stays in the denominator.
items.description: Judge score for whether the plan fits the paper and the declared time.

items.denominator_policy: Scored outside a campaign; a campaign row claiming it would be recording the harness.
items.description: Judge score for demonstrated understanding, scored against the calibration set.

items.denominator_policy: A judge failure scores null and stays in the denominator.
